# IT Security Protocol and Database Migration Standards

This document details key action items related to IT security protocols and database management:

*   Monitor encryption standards based on audit recommendations.
*   Optimize encryption standards through regular updates.
*   Investigate database migration processes quarterly.
*   Optimize database migration based on audit findings.
*   Review encryption standards updates regularly.
